spots.name: Washington Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 462 m (1,516 ft).

spots.name: Tanyard Creek Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 4 m (12 ft) tall.
